scope: One immutable M2 S1 current-UID application of unchanged existing M1 PT/TPL definitions with an explicitly separate M1 prerequisite semantic RPM and M2 registered target; six runtime/helper files and their focused fixture. Scratch candidate only until root integration hash readback.

method.reasonNoDuplicateTestRun: The frozen implementation was unchanged across the author’s actual 21-case focused execution. The independent reviewer inspected the exact test cases, execution log and hashes rather than repeating identical fixture execution.

findings.finding: The helper checks the native accepted M1-RPM-042 path against immutable and current M1 crosswalk/master leaf separately from the explicit source/native M2-1 target parent and exact MIDDLE2 binding. M2 target lookup M2-RPM-030 cannot replace the semantic primary or create a hybrid path.

An in-process WeakMap capability is minted only after full typed evidence validation. Its whole-question, final-row and exact semantic-record digests are rechecked at the ordinary RPM provenance boundary. A request JSON object or copied proof cannot manufacture it. Source-declared rpmPrimaryId, curriculum and path checks remain enforced, and selectsPtTpl remains false.

Exact Git commits and raw SHA references bind root approval, proposal, current application and independent review at approval and selected-item level. Distinct root, proposal preparer, native reviewer and independent reviewer identities are required. All four independently reviewed source snapshots and the selected native item are authenticated.

The native REGISTRATION_PENDING decision, native absent PT/TPL after values and exactly empty proposal inventories are required and preserved. Newly authorized current application is a separate typed proof. Retained primaryMethod/decisiveStep and native RPM aliases receive explicit current-application origins instead of NATIVE_AFTER.

The existing 25-field student payload, text-only boundary, current and native source/content holds, all five accepted difficulty fields, original source approval flags and exact rationale are checked. The immutable source transition admits only the declared metadata additions/removals and requires every unselected question to be identical. Ordinary registrar source/metadata parity, exact file blob, UID, fingerprint, target parent and registry-scope guards remain in the execution path.

Existing ACTIVE PT and TPL objects must match immutable approved definitions and remain equal before/after. Exactly one add-only target binding for the selected UID is admitted; definition and crosswalk changes are zero. Replay reconstructs only an authenticated original add-only binding in a cloned lookup map, with no canonical file write or unrelated state reconstruction.

The new opt-in joins the existing source-review sidecar and receipt inventory. Proof/sidecar removal is rejected during replay and native reuse. The original request snapshot and exact issued proof remain authenticated before reuse; a later source-only request can preserve the unchanged selected UID while updating a different question in the same file, without issuing a new approval.

Current selected source, selected semantic crosswalk row, master leaf/target parent, definitions and binding are re-read/rechecked. An unrelated crosswalk append is not treated as a change to the selected semantic authority. Initial unselected-source mutation is rejected, while a later independently issued source-only rebind is supported with the earlier typed proof intact.
